pages.title: Nototherium
pages.text: $(o)Nototherium$() ($(o)Nototherium mitchelli$()) was a stocky, short-faced diprotodont that lived in eastern Australia during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It was smaller than Diprotodon, with a broad muzzle suited to cropping low vegetation.$(br2)Its remains are often found alongside those of other large Pleistocene marsupials.
